'''Brejik's Run Outpost''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] outpost in the [[Tularan Marsh]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Named after the nearby [[Brejik's Run]] swoop track, which lay in ruins, the outpost was established as a forward outpost for the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[invasion of Taris]], the Republic was in the process of excavating a buried swoop track known as [[Gadon's Superhighway]], which was accessible via a tunnel in the outpost, but Imperial forces overran the outpost and collapsed the tunnel and excavations.
